review: Direct inspection of isometric, support detail and both fixed-registration manual overlays on24September2026.
observations: Both sides retain symmetric lower brake-stop installations; revised stud bosses and connecting webs replace the earlier block-like lower casting.
The diagonal support more closely follows HB134/135 after revising the explicitly estimated lower stud station and cap seat.
The crossbar remains a transverse-layout hypothesis. M341/M342 are not asserted aliases of MX95/MX96.
Fixed registration retains a14.43mm low residual in HB134 and24.32mm low in HB135, plus2.82mm forward/10.65mm aft respectively.
The source overlays display stop components, not full casting contours; the rendered boss/web profile remains estimated.
